title: De'Von Achane doesn't want to hear about 2026 being a rebuilding year

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: De'Von Achane doesn't want to hear about 2026 being a rebuilding year
sources.description: Running back De'Von Achane signed a four-year contract extension with the Dolphins this month, but he's not taking the long view when it comes to the Dolphins turning into a winning team.
